desc:
🚚 Welcome to Drive a Base!

🪵 Gather materials across the desert
🔨 Build and expand your base & decorate it
💥 Unlock new weapons & get stronger
👥 Make or join a team with up to 4 players & fight together
💰 Steal chests and resources from other players
🧟 Survive zombies, monsters, storms & bosses

🐙 Watch the sand. Something lives under it...

📱 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console
👍 Like & Favorite if you had fun!
